description: Hand-verified gold set for the iMac Product Environmental Report (Oct 2024). reference_pages are 1-based PDF pages checked against the PDF text.

items.question: What is the total product carbon footprint of the iMac (two ports) 256GB?
items.ground_truth: The total product footprint of the iMac (two ports) 256GB is 346 kg CO2e.

items.question: What is the carbon footprint of the iMac (four ports) 512GB configuration?
items.ground_truth: The iMac (four ports) 512GB has a carbon footprint of 391 kg CO2e.

items.question: What is the life cycle breakdown of the iMac (two ports) 256GB carbon footprint by phase?
items.ground_truth: Production 50%, transportation 5%, product use 45%, and end-of-life processing less than 1%.

items.question: What are the baseline emissions for iMac and how much were emissions reduced?
items.ground_truth: Baseline emissions are 445 kg; the reduction is 99 kg, bringing iMac emissions to 346 kg.

items.question: What is the iMac's power consumption in Idle with the display on at 115V?
items.ground_truth: 20.6 W at 115V in the Idle - Display On mode.

items.question: How much power does the iMac consume in sleep mode at 230V?
What is the iMac's power consumption when off at 100V?
What is the power adapter efficiency of the iMac at 230V?
items.ground_truth: The power adapter efficiency at 230V is 91.9%.

items.question: How does the iMac's energy use compare with the ENERGY STAR requirement?
items.ground_truth: iMac uses 58 percent less energy than the requirement for ENERGY STAR.

items.question: What percentage of recycled content does the iMac contain, and what is 100 percent recycled in the stand?
items.ground_truth: iMac contains more than 15 percent recycled content, and the stand uses 100 percent recycled aluminum.

items.question: How much recycled plastic does the iMac use?
items.ground_truth: At least 50 percent recycled plastic in 13 components.

items.question: What share of rare earth elements in the iMac magnets is recycled?
items.ground_truth: 100 percent recycled rare earth elements are used in all magnets, representing 99 percent of the total rare earth elements in the device.

items.question: What percentage of the iMac fiber packaging is recycled content, and is the packaging plastic-free?
items.ground_truth: The packaging contains 76 percent recycled content in fiber packaging; it is 100 percent fiber-based with no plastic except inks, coatings, and adhesives.

items.question: How does the report define low-carbon electricity?
items.ground_truth: Low-carbon electricity refers to both renewable electricity and other fossil-free projects Apple considers low-carbon but not renewable, like nuclear and large-impact hydroelectricity. Apple accounts for the carbon impact of building and operating them, so they are low-carbon but not zero-carbon.

items.question: How many years of power use does Apple assume for macOS devices in the carbon footprint use phase?
items.ground_truth: Apple assumes a four-year period for power use by first owners of macOS, iPadOS, and tvOS devices.

items.question: How can customers recover or recycle their iMac at end of life?
items.ground_truth: Return the device through Apple Trade In, in-store or online; if it is not eligible for credit, Apple recycles it for free through take-back and recycling programs.
